invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破638（基于ATR 3.35和日线熊市调整），或融资费率Z-score回落至30%以下（空头风险缓解）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 638 (adjusted based on ATR 3.35 and daily bearish trend), or funding Z-score falls below 30% (short risk eases).

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破0.092（基于ATR 0.0013和支撑），或融资费率Z-score回升至-50%以上（空头风险缓解）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 0.092 (based on ATR 0.0013 and support), or funding Z-score rises above -50% (short risk eases).

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破2125（基于ATR 18.02调整），或融资费率Z-score回升至50%以上（多头拥挤增加），或日线趋势转熊（价格跌破SMA50 2061.85）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 2125 (adjusted based on ATR 18.02), or funding Z-score rises above 50% (long crowding increases), or daily trend turns bearish (price < SMA50 2061.85).
